stage.name: Flooded Seashore
stage.description:
An unassuming beach on the coastline of Siesta currently overrun by Sicilians and rioters. Utilize the Command Terminals provided by the city of Siesta and apprehend them posthaste.
<Special Conditions> DP will not regenerate naturally.

sicilian.name: Sicilian
sicilian.flavourText: A basic melee combatant. These Siracusans adorn themselves with an ancient name, symbolizing the glory of an era bygone.

elite_sicilian.name: Elite Sicilian
elite_sicilian.flavourText: A basic melee combatant with higher combat capabilities than a normal Sicilian. These Siracusans adorn themselves with an ancient name, symbolizing the glory of an era bygone.

brawler.name: Brawler
brawler.flavourText: Combat personnel who have underwent special training. Their flurry of rapid blows are powerful enough to be fatal.

arts_master_a1.name: Arts Master A1
arts_master_a1.flavourText: An unmanned enemy drone with extremely high movement speed, modified from the product of an Arts Education competition. It is equipped with an Arts Weapon module that allows it to launch long-range Arts attacks, so proceed with caution. Based on available data, its weapon module also allows it to block some Arts damage.

elite_brawler.name: Elite Brawler
elite_brawler.flavourText: Exceptionally dangerous combatants who are even more destructive than normal Brawlers. Only the most heavily-armored Operators can withstand their blows.

marksman.name: Marksman
marksman.flavourText: Tactical long-range combatants. Adept at oppressing enemies with continuous fire, their tactical literacy means they will prefer targeting our command terminal in order to cut off support.

elite_marksman.name: Elite Marksman
elite_marksman.flavourText: Tactical long-range combatants, more dangerous than a normal Marksman. Adept at oppressing enemies with continuous fire, their tactical literacy means they will prefer targeting our command terminal in order to cut off support. Proceed with caution.

sniper.name: Sniper
sniper.flavourText: A basic ranged soldier. They have very long range. Their sniper rifles can launch special ammunition capable of stunning our Operators.
abilities: After two attacks, the next attack Stuns its target

authorized_caster.name: Authorized Caster
authorized_caster.flavourText: A basic caster soldier. Arts have been one of the most threatening forms of warfare since ancient times, and a large amount of research has gone into adapting Arts for contemporary warfare.

authorized_caster_leader.name: Authorized Caster Leader
authorized_caster_leader.flavourText: A basic caster soldier, more threatening than a normal Authorized Caster. Arts have been one of the most threatening forms of warfare since ancient times, and a large amount of research has gone into adapting Arts for contemporary warfare.

sniper_leader.name: Sniper Leader
sniper_leader.flavourText: A basic ranged soldier. They are stronger than normal Snipers, firing improved ammunition that stuns for a longer duration. Proceed with caution.
abilities: After two attacks, the next attack Stuns its target

agent.name: Agent
agent.flavourText: A caster who utilizes coordinated tactics. They are able to enhance their melee attacks with Arts damage, and employ a variety of techniques to break through unprepared defenders.
abilities: Attacks temporarily reduce allied units' Block

bully.name: Bully
bully.flavourText: Special melee combatants. Their unstoppable bulk is equivalent to blocking three normal enemies, and Operators who cannot block three enemies may not be able to halt their advance at all.
abilities: Can only be blocked by Operators with 3 or more Block

fanatic.name: Fanatic
fanatic.flavourText: Special long-range combatants. Wielding a massive iron hammer, they boast enormous destructive potential and will targeted attacking facilities first. They can also hit Operators stationed on high ground.

agent_leader.name: Agent Leader
agent_leader.flavourText: A caster who utilizes coordinated tactics. They are stronger than normal Agents. They are able to enhance their melee attacks with Arts damage, and employ a variety of techniques to break through unprepared defenders.
abilities: Attacks temporarily reduce allied units' Block

desperate_fanatic.name: Desperate Fanatic
desperate_fanatic.flavourText: Special long-range combatants, with greater combat capabilities than normal Fanatics. Wielding a massive iron hammer, they boast enormous destructive potential and will targeted attacking facilities first. They can also hit Operators stationed on high ground.

bulldozer.name: Bulldozer
bulldozer.flavourText: Special melee combatants. Their unstoppable bulk is equivalent to blocking three normal enemies, and Operators who cannot block three enemies may not be able to halt their advance at all. Compared to a normal Bully, they boast greater attack power and armor.
abilities: Can only be blocked by Operators with 3 or more Block

arts_master_a2.name: Arts Master A2
arts_master_a2.flavourText: An unmanned enemy drone that had some of its Flight Support modules swapped out, trading speed for a more powerful Arts Weapon module. Capable of using long-range Arts attacks. Proceed with caution. Based on available data, its weapon module also allows it to block some Arts damage.
